title: Historical score timeline
caption: First 45 seconds of the stored pinch_in-ae0a22bf timeline. Vertical styles distinguish caught/missed reference starts; triangles mark actual stored emissions and background bands show stored gesture intervals. Scores/times were rounded by the original exporter. This is not a fresh inference run or a CNNv2 trace.

title: Sensor delivery timing

alt: PPG and IMU gap histograms distinguish real sampling/delivery from the inference grid.
transformations: Counts normalized within stream; original tail clipping explicitly retained.

title: Motion-history recovery
caption: Counts transcribed programmatically from the original motion-hangover report for its 50-start pinch-in experiment. This is peak-window detection after a synthetic splice, not standard event recall, not raw replay regeneration, and not a live physical-motion study. No confidence intervals are asserted.
alt: Before/after scaling counts show recovery at five delays after a spliced six-second movement.
transformations: Reported counts divided by 50; straight lines connect only the five documented conditions.

title: CNNv2 operating points
caption: Each model is plotted at its stored chosen threshold. The two final V2 operating points were independently reselected from saved training-OOF budget tables; reference/app thresholds are stored values. This is a descriptive comparison, not an isolated component ablation. Repeated historical test exploration limits confirmatory interpretation; zero observed FA is not zero long-run risk.
evidence_status: stored benchmark with verified OOF threshold arithmetic
alt: Context-specific event recall and false activations for four stored model operating points.
transformations: Recall=100*caught/gestures; FAR=fa/negative_hours; no threshold optimized against test groups.

title: Multiclass confusion matrix
caption: Independently recomputed from all saved seed-17 held-out decision vectors. Rows are delayed annotated states; cells show row percentage and exact decision count. This is not onset-event accuracy or physical hold-duration accuracy.
alt: Four-class confusion matrix exposes weaker hold recall despite high overall accuracy.
transformations: Argmax of stored probabilities; exact integer counts; row-normalized percentages.

title: Seed variation
caption: All three models are shown, not an ensemble or a test-selected best seed. Accuracy, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 were recomputed from saved vectors. Seed variation on one split is not participant uncertainty.
alt: Three models have high overall accuracy but lower class-balanced scores.
transformations: No transformation beyond labelled plotting of source values.

alt: Three panels report event recall, false activations and latency for pinch-in, pinch-out and hold entry.
